Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 -c "
import struct
data = open('src/test/OpenEXRTest/comp_piz.exr','rb').read()
# dataWindow: xMin,yMin,xMax,yMax
dw = struct.unpack('<iiii', data[331-16-16:331-16])  # not right, recompute
# header ends at 331. dataWindow attr value is 16 bytes
# find dataWindow attr
i=8
attrs={}
while i < len(data):
    j = data.index(b'\x00', i); name=data[i:j]; i=j+1
    if name==b'': break
    k=data.index(b'\x00',i); typ=data[i:k]; i=k+1
    sz=struct.unpack('<I',data[i:i+4])[0]; i+=4
    val=data[i:i+sz]; i+=sz
    attrs[name]=val
dw=struct.unpack('<iiii', attrs[b'dataWindow'])
print('dataWindow', dw)
print('compression', attrs[b'compression'].hex())
# scanline offset table: height = yMax-yMin+1
h = dw[3]-dw[1]+1
print('height', h)
off_start = 331
off_table = []
for y in range(h):
    o = struct.unpack('<Q', data[off_start+y*8: off_start+y*8+8])[0]
    off_table.append(o)
print('first offsets', off_table[:5])
print('last offsets', off_table[-3:])
print('max offset', max(off_table))
print('file len', len(data))
